Hi all — thanks for the quick responses. A few implementation confirmations from our side after internal prep: 

1) Admin invites / projects:
- We'll provision a SmartClinic project namespace: smartclinic-prod-poc.
- Seed invites for two admins now (please confirm emails). We'll hold the third invite until you flip to pilot.

  $ redwoodctl projects create --name smartclinic-prod-poc 
  $ redwoodctl keys seed --project smartclinic-prod-poc --ttl 30d --label "poc-seed"

3) Compliance artifacts:
- W9 attached. For SOC2 please request via: redwood-secure.com/request-soc2 — we will provision a secure view for your legal team.

- Sean: calendar invite for Wed 10:00 PST (sent).
